correctness.rationale: A C_m-invariant nonempty set of cardinality k<2m contains at most one nonpolar free orbit (size m) plus P⊆{N,S}. For each P with m+|P|≤k, the continuous map S²/C_m≅S²→F_{m,k} sends the orbit to that union. It is injective off its two poles and the only collisions at the poles are exactly the polar-set identifications. Compact-to-Hausdorff gluing gives the actual homeomorphic finite sphere-sheet model. The four successive sheet types attach via an incidence graph of polar configurations: k=1 two points; 2≤k<m three points; k=m S² plus isolated point; k=m+1 three S² sheets and graph β1=1; k≥m+2 below 2m four sheets and graph β1=2. Hence the stated integral wedges and injectivity of homology under sheet attachments. Independent finite incidence calculation m=3 gave (components,H1,H2)=(2,0,0),(3,0,0),(2,0,1),(1,1,3),(1,2,4) at k=1..5. This check alone does not prove all m.
